channel.title: 52 at 52 · 52 km a week
channel.description: Season 2 of 52@52: 52 credited km every week (run km + ride km / 2). New activities, completed weeks, summaries and reviews.

item.title: Week 1 · Activity 1: Lake Chabot Trail Run 30K
item.description:
Run · 28.69 km · 3:18:21

Season 2 kicks off with a 30 km trail race (well, 28.69 km according to my watch), 660 m of climbing, two great friends, a sneaky rock in my shoe, and a podium mystery.

A temporada 2 começa com uma corrida de trilha de 30 km (bom, 28,69 km segundo o meu relógio), 660 m de subida, dois grandes amigos, uma pedrinha atrevida no tênis e um mistério no pódio.

item.title: Week 1 · Activity 2: Home to the Bay (minus the first 7 km)
item.description:
Ride · 34.3 km · 1:35:44

A cool, cloudy ride to Alviso Marina and NASA Ames on legs still recovering from the 30K, with the first 7 km lost because I forgot to press Start.

Um pedal fresco e nublado até a Alviso Marina e a NASA Ames, com as pernas ainda se recuperando dos 30K, e os primeiros 7 km perdidos porque esqueci de apertar o Start.

item.description:

Um pedal curto com a Paula até a Penitencia Creek Trail e de volta para completar o desafio da Semana 1 antes de ir ao cinema.
